Both assigned reviewer deliverables are ready for owner review. No reviewer-side blocker remains.

previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h, w~11-14) with 3-4 SHAPES in distinct non-bg colors, MIXING SOLID BLOBS (no holes, 3-6 cells) and HOLLOW FRAMES (4-conn rectangles with 1 interior hole, ~4×4 to 5×5). Each shape is placed at an isolated position. Rule: identify each shape's HOLE COUNT and AREA (number of cells). SORT all shapes by (hole count DESC, area DESC) — frames-with-holes first, then solid blobs by size. PACK the sorted shapes into the output left-to-right (with 1-cell separators) keeping each shape's color. Output: a packed gallery showing the shapes in sorted order. Net: input is a scattered mixed-shape scene; output is the same shapes re-arranged by (holes, size) ranking.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The object crops and their exact area/hole/bounding-box descriptors, together with the area-first ranked sequence selected from those descriptors.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Extract every nonzero 4-connected monochrome object, crop it to its bounding box, and compute the input-derived descriptor tuple (occupied area, enclosed-hole count, bounding box).
sequential_dependency.step_b: Sort the descriptor records by area descending, then hole count descending, then bounding box; horizontally pack the corresponding crops with one zero column between them and vertical centering.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: B cannot choose the crop sequence without A’s descriptors. Replacing the area-first intermediate ordering with the canonical holes-first ordering moves several differently shaped colored crops, so protected Racket produces a different packed final grid.
